T_tot_def: T_tot = dT_cmblens + dT_tsz + dT_cib, summed as alms per band (kSZ not included)
units: D_l = l(l+1)C_l/2pi in muK^2 (thermodynamic temperature), beam-convolved
binning: 400 grid points: unique(round(logspace(log10 2, log10 6000, M))) with the smallest M giving 400 integers (every integer up to l=85, log-spaced above). Bin edges at the geometric midpoints sqrt(l_i l_(i+1)); first edge 2, last 6000. Integer l belongs to bin i if ell_edges[i] <= l < ell_edges[i+1] (l=6000 in the last bin), so every integer 2..6000 is used once. Dl and beam_B2 are (2l+1)-weighted averages over each bin; dlnell = ln(ell_edges[i+1]/ell_edges[i]) (sum = ln(ell_max/ell_min)); n_modes = sum over the bin of (2l+1).

notes.Dl_cross_in_T_tot: D_Ttot - (D_cmblens + D_tsz + D_cib) per band, binned the same way: the exact sum of the cross terms 2 sum_{X<Y} D_XY inside T_tot.
notes.deconvolve: Divide Dl by beam_B2 for the beam-deconvolved spectrum (bin-consistent).
notes.mixing: D_mix = sum_X D_X + 2 sum_{X<Y} r_XY sqrt(D_X D_Y), r from cross_data.json (71 bins) interpolated in ln l. Computed when this file was written (mix_check): CMB + tSZ + CIB reproduces T_tot to max |D_mix/D_Ttot - 1| of 1.15% at 93, 0.62% at 143, 0.60% at 145, 1.44% at 225, 3.46% at 280, 10.01% at 353 GHz. |rel| exceeds 1% in places at 93 GHz up to l = 52; 225 GHz up to l = 110; 280 GHz up to l = 989; 353 GHz up to l = 989. At 353 GHz the max |rel| per l range is 2-10: 1.5%, 10-30: 6.6%, 30-100: 10%, 100-300: 6.1%, 300-1000: 3.4%, 1000-3000: 0.7%, 3000-6000: 0.051%. The residual is not a bias (|mean rel| <= 0.1% in every range and band): it is the sample scatter of this single realization's cross spectra D_XY on the fine grid bins around their average over each wider r bin, which a binned r cannot follow. Its rms matches the expected sample scatter sqrt(4 sum_{X<Y} D_X D_Y (1 + r^2)/n_modes)/D_Ttot (rms/expected 0.72-1.21 for l >= 30; below l = 30 the r bins are nearly as narrow as the grid bins, so the residual is smaller). The scatter is largest where the grid bins hold few modes (low l) and the cross terms are a large fraction of T_tot (bright CIB, high bands). Dl_cross (present only after a raw-alm run of precompute_cross.py) gives the per-pair D_XY on this grid for an exact mix.

mix_check.what: D_mix(dT_cmblens + dT_tsz + dT_cib; r from cross_data.json interpolated in ln l) against Dl.T_tot, from the rounded arrays in this file. rel = D_mix/D_Ttot - 1. by_range: max |rel|, mean rel, rms rel and the rms expected from the sample scatter of the cross spectra on the grid bins, sqrt(4 sum_{X<Y} D_X D_Y (1 + r^2)/n_modes)/D_Ttot. last_ell_above_threshold: largest grid l with |rel| > threshold.

cross_data.estimator: v1 values, not recomputed: r = mean_b(C_XY)/sqrt(mean_b(C_XX) mean_b(C_YY)) with UNWEIGHTED means over the inclusive bin (beam-convolved spectra; clipped to [-1, 1]; 4 decimals); ell = arithmetic midpoint of the edges. A rerun of precompute_cross.py replaces this with half-open, (2l+1)-weighted bins.
